item.title: Allergens (full list)
item.description: Allergens: 1. Gluten 2. Eggs 3. Fish 4. Peanuts 5. Crustaceans 6. Milk 7. Soy 8. Sesame 9. Nuts 10. Celery 11. Mustard 12. Lupine 13. Sulphur dioxide 14. Molluscs 15. Garlic

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Mushroom and asparagus vol-au-vents topped with parsley. Served with an apple and celeriac salad with mustard vinaigrette on the side. Also available gluten free with crisp taco shells. (1+6+10+11+13)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Chana masala, Indian chickpea curry, with jeera rice and topped with namkeen. Served with a cucumber and mint raita, coriander and lime. The dish is gluten free. (4+6+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: White beans and mushrooms with salt-baked celeriac and sauce café de Paris, the world’s best sauce. (6+10+11+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Dal with the big autumn hero, pumpkin, served with naan bread and yoghurt. (1+6)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Spinach and ricotta tortelloni in an umami-rich tomato sauce with plenty of vegetables and cannellini beans, topped with crisp, Italian-spiced homemade potato crisps. Served with an Italian salad of endive, rocket and grapes tossed in a red wine vinaigrette, chilli sauce and whipped ricotta. Also available gluten free. (1+2+6+13+15)
